title: 214Pb in the mixed-flow state: what the unavailable radon tag costs and whether 214Pb-driven MSSI could be elevated around 16 June 2023
question: What fraction of the exposure was in the mixed-flow state (radon tag off), how does the flow state affect the 214Pb SS/MSSI rates, what 214Pb activity does Table I imply, what transient elevation would make 214Pb MSSI a 10% explanation of the event and is it allowed by the ER and alpha rates, and what would a negative or positive radon tag have proved?
headline_result: LZ's HE-SB tag statistics (12/18 events in tag-active periods) put 33% (21-48%) of the exposure in mixed flow, so the untaggable timing is unremarkable; Table I implies 5.2 (3.1-6.7) uBq/kg of 214Pb; a 214Pb-MSSI origin at the event position needs a >= 2.7e5 (24 h) or 6.5e6 (1 h) transient elevation (x100 more with the 0.010 position penalty) while the ROI ER rate allows only 3.4 (24 h) / 22 (1 h) at 3 sigma; a negative tag would have had LR = 0.40-0.44, a positive tag LR = 6-60
key_numbers: f_active 12/18 = 0.67 (68% 0.52-0.79, 95% 0.41-0.87); mixed-flow days 73 (46-105); P(event in mixed flow) 0.33; tag eff 7/12 = 0.58; mixed-flow RFR-MSSI enhancement < 1.7 (95%) at f_m = 0.33, < 2.8 at 0.2; chain 3.10 min/26.8 min/19.9 min/164 us; transport per mean life 38.7 min: bulk 0.6-2 cm, ion drift 22-224 cm; ROI ER window 1.35-18.9 keVee; gs acceptance 2.18%; N_dec 4.7e5/run, 2120/day, 5.2 (3.1-6.7) uBq/kg; event 352 keV reach dead region 5.3e-6 (RFR 2.4e-6, shell 3.2e-7), 295 keV 4.8e-7, 242 keV 1.2e-9; FV edge 6.9e-3; topology prob 1.0e-8/decay; position penalty 0.010 (lambda bracket 0.002-0.045); HE-SB RFR 14-18 vs 21.5; wall ROI 0.0037 vs 0.0048; k_flat 884-2063 (share 0.7-0.3), k_24h 2.7e5, k_1h 6.5e6; ER 3 sigma k_min 3.4 (24 h), 22 (1 h); k = 10 for 24 h adds 38 events; alpha 131/h, k = 2 in 11 min; LR_neg 0.40-0.44, LR_pos 6-60
model_or_mechanism: Clopper-Pearson binomial on LZ's radon-tag sideband counts; radioactivedecay chain timing with v*tau transport; Fermi beta spectrum through the NEST-LZ ROI window to invert Table I; isotropic gamma ray-tracing in a 72.8 x 145.6 cm cylinder to the 3 mm wall shell and 13.75 cm RFR; Poisson detectability of transient 214Pb elevations in the ROI ER and alpha rates; binary-tag likelihood ratios
stance: neutral (tool, projection, or constraint) - closes the 214Pb mixed-flow MSSI route; mixed-flow timing unremarkable
confidence: high for fractions and geometry ratios, medium for the absolute activity
